|game_text=Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand (or from top of Lost Pile) face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).
|errata_history={{Card errata/Tracked Fleet}}
This is version PC-E1 (2 of 2), 11 May 2026. It is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Playtest''' ([[Tracked Fleet (Playtest)]]): Playtest image: PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-tf-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Prints “relocate it to another system within 3 parsecs”. Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to another system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
* '''Original''' ([[Tracked Fleet]]): PC card image of 8 August 2025<ref name="ht-tf-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/9d996b04c1e064cc623ec4df63817a3e2970f555/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/9d996b04c1e064cc623ec4df63817a3e2970f555 9d996b0] (8 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “relocate it to another system” becomes “relocate it to an [Episode VII] system”. The same text is printed on the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF built 10 August 2025, page 3). Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
*: This version's card image was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 10 August 2025, with the same words ([[:File:V25-D-trackedfleet-2025-08-10-sheet-slip.png|slip]]); the slip prints no errata mark. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on [[Tracked Fleet]].
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of 11 May 2026<ref name="ht-tf-2">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/bdead15a7ab043de85efd24400218d42bd6eb0a2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/bdead15a7ab043de85efd24400218d42bd6eb0a2 bdead15] (11 May 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC May 2026 errata (marked “E1”): “(or from top of Lost Pile)” added after “stack a card from hand” in There Will Be No Surrender. Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand (or from top of Lost Pile) face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
